verdict.rationale: Avalara documents return preparation and filing only through separate products. The Managed Returns API is aimed at partners and platforms embedding filing into their workflows, and VAT Reporting covers VAT submission; AvaTax itself is documented as a calculation engine. A community comment notes that using Avalara still requires separately handling per-jurisdiction filing, which fits filing being a separate add-on rather than contradicting the vendor docs. missing for 10: evidence of automatic remittance of funds, evidence of filing in every registered jurisdiction, on-time filing commitments, a vendor guarantee covering late-filing penalties, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
